patterns_found.visual_evidence: Both sketches show a prominent search field in the header area near the top, visually separated as a primary control and paired with branding/navigation elements, implying user-entered search behavior.
patterns_found.behavior_notes: Search should accept text input and trigger a search action on submit; likely also needs focus styling and possibly clear/active-state behavior because the field is emphasized as a key interactive header control.
patterns_found.ambiguities: The sketches do not make clear whether results appear live/autocomplete-style or only after submit.

sketch_notes: The sketches imply a largely static article/content page in both mobile and desktop layouts, with the only clearly recurring JavaScript-dependent interaction being the prominent header search control. The rest of the page appears to be long-form content, images, tables, and lists without explicit signs of collapsible navigation, tabs, modal overlays, infinite loading, or sticky behavior. Desktop mainly changes layout density and side-by-side placement, not interaction model.
